name: local-rag
description: Hybrid keyword + semantic search over the agent's own workspace: every conversation message (mirrored to conversations/) and the files it keeps. Runs locally (mcp-local-rag). Read-only for the agent — the portal's indexer is the only writer, so the server's ingest/delete tools are removed from the run. Mounted only when LOCAL_RAG_ENTRY points at a built server (make rag-setup).
